content: The user wants to "build and return the complete route of chemicals based on the inputs". We have multiple steps: template 1 (214705) applied to target molecule yields precursors: a protected amine (tert-butyl carbamate?) and sulfonyl chloride (O=S(=O)(O)c1ccccc1F). However verification failed: the precursors we used didn't match the template. The template likely expects sulfonyl chloride with Cl not O? The original template mapping from make_8_lvl2-template_search-1 gave mapped_rxn where product is target sulfonamide and reactants are something with O=S(=O)(O)c1ccccc1F? Wait mapped_rxn: product includes ...[S:23](=[O:24])(=[O:25])O (i.e., sulfonic acid?) Actually the mapped_rxn shows product with O at S (maybe sulfonic acid). The template may be for sulfonyl chloride? The precursors from apply_template-1 gave ["CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1", "O=S(=O)(O)c1ccccc1F"] which is sulfonic acid (OH) not chloride. But verification fails, maybe because template expects Cl leaving group? The original description: "An aromatic amine attacks the electrophilic sulfur of phenylsulfonyl chloride, then the intermediate collapses to expel Cl⁻". So reactant should be phenylsulfonyl chloride (Cl). The apply_template gave O=S(=O)(O) which is sulfonic acid. So maybe need to adjust to correct precursor: O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F. Let's try verify with that.
